question: Which model gave the lowest conversion, whose kinetic parameters did it use, and what catalyst did it use?
expect: Model 5 (21%); Singh and Ali; K+ impregnated H3PW12O40.xH2O on graphene oxide (potassium-imbued phosphotungstic acid) (Table 1; sec. 2.3.5; Table 10)
rendered:
Model 5 gave the lowest conversion. 
It used power law kinetics for heterogeneous catalytic transesterification. 
The kinetic parameters of heterogeneous catalytic transesterification were taken from the study by Singh and Ali. 
It used a heterogeneous catalyst (potassium imbued phosphotungstic acid).
